title: chat-server: testkit backend conformance suite
description: Mark decided 2026-10-30 (chinwag-nuqe.25). Feature testkit = [dep:tokio] (rt, rt-multi-thread) in jmap-chat-server. src/testkit.rs: pub trait ConformanceBackend: ChatBackend { fn caller(&self, &Id) -> CallerCtx; async add_account(&Id, owner_user_id); async seed(&Id, type_name, Value) stores as given; fn take_outbound_events(&self) -> Option<Vec<OutboundEvent>> (None = skip event tests) }; tests as pub async fn name<B: ConformanceBackend>(b: B) with oracle in rustdoc; shared fixture builders; pub fn run (multi-thread runtime); #[macro_export] chat_backend_conformance!(make) emitting #[test]s. MemoryBackend impl behind cfg(all(testkit, test-helpers)); tests/backend_conformance.rs runs it. Move (keeping each oracle): integration.rs state/create/get and is_contact_blocked; patch_object_paths.rs; patch_null_defaults.rs; query_filters.rs; query_sort.rs; query_anchor.rs; space_join_invite_atomic.rs; message_burn_on_read_atomic.rs (invalid-patch test only); contact_create_identity.rs; message_threads.rs replyCount (gate on supports_threads); expiry_sweep.rs; chat_unread_count.rs (gate on maintains_unread_count; only spec-pinned assertions, since aa01dd7 makes owner-message counting implementation-defined); the create_message test from item 3. Keep handler tests using Faulty/Tracking/Injectable/IdentityBackend, backend_defaults.rs, push/permission policy tests. Additive API; public-api snapshot grows.
close_reason: Batch 36: d9a93fcb (testkit feature, ConformanceBackend, chat_backend_conformance!; additive) + 89a25aab (moved backend-contract tests; jmap-chat-server tests 1030 -> 1111) + SHOULD re-citation; local CI all green (6740 tests stable+beta).
